# Coca-Cola and PepsiCo Annual Revenue and Net Income Investigation

**Mixed**

KO revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $47.061 billion [Efaecfad5df](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $45.754 billion for 2023-12-31 [E363d5c23a2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $10.631 billion [E42d481d035](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), down from $10.714 billion for 2023-12-31 [E1b5f7d179f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). KO cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-12-31 was $2.064 billion [E7ab7110aab](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html), up from $1.852 billion for 2023-12-31 [Eedd80c0025](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2023 as-of date, Coca-Cola reported fiscal 2022 revenue of $43,004,000,000 and net income of $9,542,000,000 [E9e24d1f183](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [E9c801e9389](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html). PepsiCo reported fiscal 2022 revenue of $86,392,000,000 and net income of $8,910,000,000 for the period ended December 31, 2022 [E2b2c0d1d5e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html) [Ef4620bfe68](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html). Coca-Cola management stated an expectation for 2023 capital expenditures to be approximately $1.9 billion [E084a42b6a3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm) and anticipated that commodity and transportation costs would continue to unfavorably impact gross profit margins in 2023 [E37fcc242d9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm).

## What happened later

For fiscal year 2023, Coca-Cola reported revenue of $45,754,000,000, net income of $10,714,000,000, and actual capital expenditures of $1,852,000,000 [E363d5c23a2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E1b5f7d179f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [Eedd80c0025](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). For fiscal year 2024, Coca-Cola reported revenue of $47,061,000,000, net income of $10,631,000,000, and capital expenditures of $2,064,000,000 [Efaecfad5df](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [E42d481d035](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html) [E7ab7110aab](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). PepsiCo reported fiscal 2023 revenue of $91,471,000,000 (period ended 2023-12-30) and net income of $9,074,000,000 [Ed691b46cde](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E48f8a7eec6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html). For fiscal 2024, PepsiCo reported revenue of $91,854,000,000 (period ended 2024-12-28) and net income of $9,578,000,000 [E8329033158](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html) [Ee48b757f58](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing latest available annual periods through the outcome cutoff, Coca-Cola's revenue grew from $43,004,000,000 (FY 2022 ending 2022-12-31) to $45,754,000,000 (FY 2023 ending 2023-12-31) and $47,061,000,000 (FY 2024 ending 2024-12-31) [E9e24d1f183](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [E363d5c23a2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [Efaecfad5df](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). PepsiCo's revenue grew from $86,392,000,000 (FY 2022 ending 2022-12-31) to $91,471,000,000 (FY 2023 ending 2023-12-30) and $91,854,000,000 (FY 2024 ending 2024-12-28) [E2b2c0d1d5e](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html) [Ed691b46cde](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [E8329033158](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). Coca-Cola's net income was $9,542,000,000 in 2022, increased to $10,714,000,000 in 2023, and decreased to $10,631,000,000 in 2024 [E9c801e9389](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/0000021344-23-000011-index.html) [E1b5f7d179f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E42d481d035](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html). PepsiCo's net income increased across all comparative periods, from $8,910,000,000 in 2022 to $9,074,000,000 in 2023, and $9,578,000,000 in 2024 [Ef4620bfe68](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747623000007/0000077476-23-000007-index.html) [E48f8a7eec6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747624000008/0000077476-24-000008-index.html) [Ee48b757f58](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/77476/000007747625000007/0000077476-25-000007-index.html). PepsiCo's annual USD capex observations were unavailable under supported XBRL tags [E5b96e2debc].

## Cross-examination

Management provided a specific numeric expectation for Coca-Cola's 2023 capital expenditures of approximately $1.9 billion [E084a42b6a3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm), which was supported by actual 2023 cash property, plant, and equipment additions of $1.852 billion [Eedd80c0025](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html). Broader qualitative statements regarding commodity costs do not constitute company-wide numeric growth targets and cannot be verified by revenue outcomes [E37fcc242d9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134423000011/ko-20221231.htm). Company-wide entity metrics for revenue and net income successfully expanded across the 2023 periods, but Coca-Cola net income subsequently decreased in 2024 [E1b5f7d179f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134424000009/0000021344-24-000009-index.html) [E42d481d035](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000002134425000011/0000021344-25-000011-index.html).

## Limits

- No annual USD capex observation was available for PepsiCo under supported XBRL tags.
- Lack of point-in-time vintage data restricts historical database certainty.

sections.title: What was knowable then
sections.text: As of the March 1, 2023 as-of date, Coca-Cola reported fiscal 2022 revenue of $43,004,000,000 and net income of $9,542,000,000 [E9e24d1f183] [E9c801e9389]. sections.title: What happened later
sections.text: For fiscal year 2023, Coca-Cola reported revenue of $45,754,000,000, net income of $10,714,000,000, and actual capital expenditures of $1,852,000,000 [E363d5c23a2] [E1b5f7d179f] [Eedd80c0025]. Coca-Cola's net income was $9,542,000,000 in 2022, increased to $10,714,000,000 in 2023, and decreased to $10,631,000,000 in 2024 [E9c801e9389] [E1b5f7d179f] [E42d481d035]. PepsiCo's net income increased across all comparative periods, from $8,910,000,000 in 2022 to $9,074,000,000 in 2023, and $9,578,000,000 in 2024 [Ef4620bfe68] [E48f8a7eec6] [Ee48b757f58].
